title: Cloverfield Crossing
description: Start in broad meadow, climb clover slopes, cross a stream and squeeze through the hedge before the fields open again. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The low meadow
rooms.lesson: Stay low over the first roots. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The clover slopes
rooms.lesson: Follow the clover up the bank. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The shallow stream
rooms.lesson: Use the broad bridge stones. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: Within the hedgerow
rooms.lesson: The route narrows between the hedges. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The open field beyond
rooms.lesson: The horizon opens again. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
